title: Third-Party Liability Insurance for Embassy Vehicle Fleet
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY ALGIERS
detail_text: PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: The U.S. Embassy Algiers intends to issue a solicitation for Third-Party Liability Insurance for the Embassy Vehicle Fleet. Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Algiers will launch the solicitation on https://dz.usembassy.gov/ when it is available. The U.S. Embassy in Algiers is going to contract direct insurance coverage for the Embassy's vehicle fleet. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered. The Government plans to issue solicitation on or around March 15, 2026 . This solicitation will be issued via the website of the Embassy of the United States in Algiers. The Government intends to award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the lowest priced technically acceptable offeror who is a responsible contractor. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a firm fixed price type contract. The Primary North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code anticipated for solicitation is 524126 (Direct Property and Casualty Insurance Carriers).
